title: Small source-linked normative seed set
purpose: Initial machine-readable cross-check fixtures. These are selected from existing rule-focused regressions; this file is not an exhaustive corpus and does not certify Ukrainian output.
ipaConvention: Project broad IPA layer; not a narrow acoustic transcription and not a direct rendering of Hangul pronunciation spellings.
ukrainianTargetPolicy: Ukrainian output is deliberately excluded from normative gold labels. It must be evaluated separately as a project-specific approximation derived from IPA.

cases.runtimeDivergenceNote: Known runtime difference to preserve explicitly: the browser engine currently emits nal lo, while the Python research engine retains the lexical long-vowel marker naːl lo. This is not an alternate official pronunciation; it is a cross-runtime implementation discrepancy to resolve in a later dedicated vowel-length alignment pass.

validationPolicy: Statuses distinguish exact official examples, official dictionary entries, and controls derived from a general rule but not explicitly listed. Project IPA remains a project transcription target and is not an official NIKL IPA prescription.
